name: demo-ecommerce-api
description: E-commerce REST API over MySQL (system of record) and Elasticsearch (read model), in TypeScript

scripts.test:docker: npm run build && docker run --rm --network demo_ecommerce_default -v "$PWD":/app -w /app -e API_BASE_URL=http://api:3000 node:20-alpine sh -c "node --test dist/tests/*.test.js"
